help.speed: Machine-local translational speed used by the aerodynamic solver.
help.alpha: Angle of attack changes the incoming velocity in the pitch plane. Positive α tilts velocity from +Z toward −Y; machine geometry does not rotate.
help.beta: Sideslip angle changes incoming velocity in the yaw plane. β = 0° is zero sideslip; positive β adds a +X component.
help.p: Angular roll rate about machine-forward +Z. It contributes to each blade's local velocity through ω × r.
help.q: Angular pitch rate about machine-right +X. The pitch damping derivative is calculated from moment changes around this rate.
help.r: Angular yaw rate about machine-up +Y. The yaw damping derivative is calculated from moment changes around this rate.

components.allDescription: No physical-component assumption. May combine disconnected assemblies.
components.estimatedHelp: Spatially inferred component. This is not a verified Besiege runtime joint graph.
components.distance: Distance to blade centroid: {{value}} game units.

summary.cgHelp: Mass-weighted center of gravity in the machine-local +X right, +Y up, +Z forward frame. It is approximate where runtime Rigidbody COM is unavailable.

help.fx: Fx is the total aerodynamic force along machine-right +X.
help.fy: Fy is the total aerodynamic force along machine-up +Y.
help.fz: Fz is the total aerodynamic force along machine-forward +Z.
help.rollMoment: Total aerodynamic moment projected onto the forward +Z roll axis, measured about the selected CG.
help.pitchMoment: Total aerodynamic moment projected onto the right +X pitch axis, measured about the selected CG.
help.yawMoment: Total aerodynamic moment projected onto the up +Y yaw axis, measured about the selected CG.
help.bladePower: Sum of each blade force dotted with that blade's local velocity. It is reported in game power units; no SI conversion is available.

derivatives.title: STABILITY & DAMPING RESPONSE
derivatives.subtitle: central finite difference · raw derivatives · no qualitative rating
derivatives.staticHelp: Moment response to small changes in angle of attack α or sideslip β around the current operating point. Values are raw slopes, not a Stable/Unstable classification.
derivatives.pitchAlpha: Pitch response to angle of attack
derivatives.dampingHelp: Moment response to small angular-rate changes. The displayed slope comes directly from the recovered blade model; no Strong/Weak rating is inferred.

help.pitchAlpha: Change in pitch moment per radian of angle-of-attack change around the operating point.
help.yawBeta: Change in yaw moment per radian of sideslip change around the operating point.
help.rollBeta: Change in roll moment per radian of sideslip change around the operating point.
help.rollP: Change in roll moment as roll rate p changes around the operating point.
help.pitchQ: Change in pitch moment as pitch rate q changes around the operating point.
help.yawR: Change in yaw moment as yaw rate r changes around the operating point.

landing.description: Analyze aerodynamic forces, moments and stability directly from a local Besiege machine
landing.localNote: Processed locally · the machine file is not uploaded or persisted

group.label: Analysis group
group.help: Spatially inferred groups are estimates, not a verified Besiege runtime joint graph.

comparison.title: NUMERICAL COMPARISON
comparison.subtitle: same operating point · Δ = B − A · no ranking
comparison.loadHelp: Both machines use the same operating point. Analysis groups and disabled blades remain independent.

model.title: Model status & assumptions
model.noteForce: Vanilla Propeller id=26 and SmallPropeller id=55 use the recovered Besiege 1.90-25346 AxialDrag law.
model.noteGroups: Spatial components are estimates, not a verified runtime joint graph.
model.noteCg: CG is approximate where runtime Rigidbody COM or mass overrides are unavailable.
model.noteLimits: No SI conversion, multibody dynamics, inertia time response, or control actuation is modeled.

sweeps.title: SWEEP ANALYSIS
sweeps.samples: Only sampled solver points are shown; no curve fitting or interpolation.
sweeps.longitudinalHelp: angle of attack and pitch-rate response
sweeps.hidden: All standard graphs are hidden. Use “Visible graphs” above to restore them.

help.alpha: Shows how the selected aerodynamic quantity changes as angle of attack α changes. X is α in degrees; Y is the selected raw solver quantity.
help.pitchQ: Shows how pitching moment changes with pitch angular rate q. Its local slope is the calculated pitch damping derivative.
help.beta: Shows how the selected aerodynamic quantity changes with sideslip angle β. β = 0° is zero sideslip.
help.yawR: Shows how yawing moment changes with yaw rate r. Its local slope is the directional damping response used by the current model.
help.rollP: Shows how rolling moment changes with roll rate p. Its local slope is the roll damping response used by the current model.

contributions.help: Select which total stability or damping derivative to decompose into per-blade central-difference contributions.

blades.title: AERODYNAMIC BLADES
blades.flippedHelp: Flipped is the blade block's effective orientation flag. A What-if flip changes this virtual value without editing the BSG.

errors.tutorialLoad: Bundled tutorial aircraft could not be loaded ({{status}})
errors.loadBeforeSnapshot: Load a machine before saving a snapshot
errors.noMachineState: This state contains no machine configuration.

notices.importedDeferred: Imported settings from {{file}}; open {{machines}} .bsg to apply machine-specific state

warnings.groupUnavailable: Machine {{key}} snapshot AnalysisGroup is unavailable; using all blocks.
warnings.disabledMissing: Machine {{key}}: {{count}} disabled blade GUID(s) are absent.
warnings.groupMembersMissing: Machine {{key}}: {{count}} Blade Group member GUID(s) are absent.
warnings.overridesMissing: Machine {{key}}: {{count}} What-if blade GUID(s) are absent.
warnings.disabledIgnored: {{count}} disabled blade GUID(s) are absent and were ignored.
warnings.membersAbsent: {{count}} Blade Group member GUID(s) are absent from the loaded machine.
warnings.overridesIgnored: {{count}} What-if blade GUID(s) are absent and were ignored.
warnings.comparisonAll: Stored AnalysisGroup is unavailable; comparison uses all blocks.

contributionTable.title: PER-BLADE CENTRAL DIFFERENCE
contributionTable.help: Each row uses the same central finite difference as the total derivative, but isolates one aerodynamic blade's moment contribution.
contributionTable.flippedHelp: Stored blade orientation flag used by the recovered blade model.
contributionTable.percentHelp: Signed blade contribution divided by the total derivative. Cancellation can produce negative values or magnitudes above 100%.
